content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Research Staff posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Research Staff recruitment is 05-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Staff at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Research Staff positions at AIIMS Delhi. These are for the posts of Project Research Scientist – I and Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. For Project Research Scientist – I, it's MBBS/BDS/BHMS/BUMS/BAMS or a Master's degree in Epidemiology/Public Health/Community Medicine. For Junior Research Fellow, a Master's degree in Public Health/Life Sciences/Clinical Research/Social Sciences/Epidemiology is required.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for AIIMS Delhi Research Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive, as per the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates will be between Rs. 48000 to Rs. 73000 per month, depending on the post and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Delhi Research Staff positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a walk-in interview. Candidates are advised to prepare for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions for Research Staff at AIIMS Delhi are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Delhi apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any geographical restrictions for applicants. However, candidates should be prepared to work at AIIMS Delhi if selected.

faq.question: Q10. What is the age limit for the Research Staff positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for these posts is to be followed as per the Government of India guidelines. Specific age limits are not detailed in the provided data.
